author: Inside Edition
description: It was the first full day of jury deliberations in the Massachusetts murder trial of Lindsay Clancy. The mother has pleaded not guilty and says postpartum psychosis drove her to kill her three children in 2023. The case has sharply divided observers in America, and has brought attention to the mental health challenges women may face after giving birth. If convicted, Clancy faces life in prison. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano is at the courthouse for the 'Clancy Countdown.'
title: Lindsay Clancy Jury Deliberates Her Fate

author: Inside Edition
description: A ghostly figure in a chilling "Scream"-style mask has been terrorizing a community center in Lorton, Virginia after midnight for weeks, causing an estimated $8,000 in property damage. A suspect was apprehended by law enforcement, and Inside Edition's Steven Fabian has the startling video of the dramatic takedown. The caught-on-camera unmasking resembled a scene from the old "Scooby-Doo" cartoon series.
title: Cops Pull 'Scream' Mask Off Vandalism Suspect

author: Inside Edition
description: It could be called 'summer of bears,' with hungry ursines showing up in all kinds of places. They're even turning up in people's backyards, looking for food. And when that happens, watch out! There are steps you can take to keep bears away from your house. Put food waste in bear-proof containers, keep your barbecue clean, and store pet food inside. Experts also recommend taking down bird feeders until late in the fall.
title: How To Keep Bears Away From Your House

author: Inside Edition
description: For the first time since Dolly Parton's death earlier this week, a close family member is sharing her grief with Dolly's legions of fans. And in a special tribute to the late icon, two of her classic movies, "Steel Magnolias" and "Best Little Whorehouse in Texas," are returning to the big screen. They're being shown at 200 AMC theaters through next Wednesday. Inside Edition's Justin Finch has more.
title: Dolly Parton's Niece Shares Family's Grief Over Icon's Death

author: Inside Edition
description: Imagine getting a postcard in the mail, sent over a quarter century ago. That's what happened to a California man named Bob Sheppard, who told Inside Edition's Jim Moret about a very special delivery. The senders are no longer here, but the sentiment contained in the note is a touching reminder of a family's love. The heartwarming, if very much delayed, correspondence is being described as "a postcard from heaven."
title: Man Receives 'Postcard From Heaven'

author: Inside Edition
description: The final victim of a serial killer has been identified at last. The Riverside County District Attorney's Office in California says a woman, whose body was found on the side of a highway in August 1992, has been ID'd as Lydia Jane Wade McWhorter of Texas. Investigators say she was 26 at the time she crossed paths with Keith Hunter Jesperson, also known as The Happy Face Killer. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Final Victim Of Happy Face Killer Identified As Jane McWhorter Of Texas
